verdict.rationale: Brex marketing claims a built-in "AI-powered expense assistant" and AI-powered automation of invoice entry, approval, and payments, so some in-product AI help exists. The evidence is only one-line marketing copy and does not show what tasks users can actually hand off to the assistant. The MCP server lets outside AI assistants act on a Brex account, which is not a built-in assistant, and the community posts raise accuracy worries rather than concrete failures of the shipped assistant. Missing for 10: documentation of the assistant's capabilities and scope, evidence of delegating multi-step tasks, a description of the in-app interaction model, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
